title: Structural Hierarchy — Shadow Database Elimination
description: Replace all hardcoded inline data in engines with service layer calls. sessions.title: Rewire Physics Constants + Pricing Policy
knowledge: src/physics/constants.ts (canonical source — thermal constants verified present in ARCH-MS0)
sessions.intent: All physics values come from one canonical source. Pricing policy is configurable, not compiled into engine code. A shop owner can change markup tables without recompiling. A machinist can trust that physics values are consistent across all engines.

units.title: Rewire AdvancedCalculations — import canonical physics constants with value snapshot
units.description: SNAPSHOT-DIFF PROTOCOL: 1) Log current inline values (CHIP_HEAT_FRACTION, TOOL_HEAT_FRACTION, STEEL_THERMAL_EXPANSION, all STABILITY_CONSTANTS). 2) Log values from constants.ts for the same keys. 3) Assert numerical equality. 4) Only then replace inline with import. If any value differs, document the discrepancy and use the constants.ts value (canonical wins). Replace inline STABILITY_CONSTANTS and THERMAL_CONSTANTS (line 114-130) with imports from PhysicsConstantsService or directly from src/physics/constants.ts.
